# Central Asia Partners

> Central Asia Partners is a free, bilingual (English/Russian) learning platform offering self-paced courses in financial literacy, business creation, and leadership development, built for people in Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan) and open to everyone. Learners create a free account, choose their language, and progress through weekly modules of daily lessons, stories, interactive worksheets, and community chat.

Website: https://learn.centralasiapartners.com
Russian version: https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/ru

## Courses

- [Financial Literacy Course](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/course/financial-literacy): Free 6-week course — financial snapshot, money scripts, income mapping, zero-based budgeting, debt snowball vs avalanche, emergency fund, and goal setting. Russian: https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/ru/course/financial-literacy
- [Business Creation Course](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/course/business-creation): Free 12-week lean-startup course — customer discovery, value proposition, business model canvas, assumption mapping, validation experiments, MVP, financial dashboard, traction, pitch. Russian: https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/ru/course/business-creation
- [Leadership Development Course](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/course/leadership-development): Free 12-week course — leading yourself, others, teams, organizations (Covey, Goleman, Tuckman, Lencioni, Kotter, Maxwell, Greenleaf). Russian: https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/ru/course/leadership-development

## Programs & Community

- [Learning path](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/programs): Four stages — financial literacy, business creation, leadership, community
- [Community](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/community): Course chat, live cohorts, local groups, facilitator pathway
- [Live cohorts](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/cohort): Facilitator-led groups
- [Free resources](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/resources): Toolkits and worksheets
- [Debt payoff calculator](https://learn.centralasiapartners.com/tools/debt-calculator): Snowball vs avalanche comparison tool
